_comment: English Grade 1 Learner's Book — art spec for tools/genimage.js.
Keys are picNN-<what>: each fills picture slot NN (an artSlots entry in the
overrides), numbered as in the picture brief. genimage.js appends the house style
to every prompt, so each prompt says only what the picture must show.
A slot that already has its `art` (supplied pictures: see _comment_artSlots in the
overrides) has no prompt here, so a generation run can never overwrite it.
PIC 64 (the -all word wheel) was supplied, with its centre lettering corrected.
Where the author wanted a word printed on a picture (PIC 43-47: 'one cup and the
word cup on it'), the picture is drawn without it: the book's own text carries the
words, and the model mis-spells lettering.

pic36-thin-tooth-three-thumb.prompt: A set of separate spot illustrations on a plain white background, side by side in one row with clear space between them, each one simple and easy for a six-year-old to name: a very thin stick, a single tooth, three oranges, a hand giving a thumbs-up.

pic37-qu-words.prompt: A set of separate spot illustrations on a plain white background, side by side in one row with clear space between them, each one simple and easy for a six-year-old to name: a duck with its beak open, quacking; a queen wearing a crown; two bottles of liquid.

pic49-er-words.prompt: A set of separate spot illustrations on a plain white background, side by side in one row with clear space between them, each one simple and easy for a six-year-old to name: a chalkboard duster, a sheet of paper, a pair of slippers, a block of butter.

pic75-which-game.prompt: Four panels in a row showing six-year-old Zambian children playing: 1. two children looking through magnifying glasses; 2. children touching their heads as the teacher leads; 3. a cat, a hat and a mat side by side; 4. a cat, an ant and a tree side by side.
